Product description Designed for electric guitar players, the Walrus Audio Warhorn is an overdrive pedal designed primarily for rhythm playing or for securing leads in Americana, country, and blues genres. With a more muted tone compared to other overdrive pedals, the pedal provides control over bass, treble, level, and drive, as well as a toggle switch. This switch changes the clipping behavior. The up position gives you a more compressed tone, while the bottom position is more open and dynamic. The Warhorn features true bypass circuitry to ensure a pristine tone when the pedal is disengaged. It requires a 9V power supply to run, which is available separately. Controls at a Glance Level: The Level knob sets the overall output of the pedal. Bass: This allows you to boost or cut bass frequencies.Treble: This affords you the ability to boost or cut treble frequencies.Drive: The Drive knob controls the level of distortionToggle Switch: Offers two flavors of clippingOn/Off True Bypass Switch: Press this switch to turn the pedal on (effect mode) and again to turn it off (bypass mode).
